name: GTA V Angel Announcer
creator: lilbradly
description:
Replaces Announcer with AI Assistant 'Angel' from GTA V

Seems like no one or very little people, have made a 'gooner' announcer mod. 

I did what i could to make all her voicelines fit somewhere, Took me 2 days to put this together :)

Make sure you adjust announcer volume in game first if too quiet or loud.
Audio has been amplified before release as it was too quiet i found.
